title: Indigo Block Print Kurta Set: Office to Weekend Styling
excerpt: How to wear an indigo hand block print kota doria kurta set from Monday at the office to weekend brunch, with a simple seven-day styling plan.
body:
An indigo block print kurta set goes from office to weekend with a few simple swaps: wear it with loafers, studs and the dupatta folded for work, then add sneakers, a denim jacket or bold silver jewellery for brunch and errands. Indigo is calm, smart and forgiving, and the light kota doria kurta with printed cotton pants is comfortable from a morning meeting to a Sunday walk.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. This set is hand block printed by karigars and stitched in our own Jaipur unit.*

**Quick answer**

- Office: loafers, small studs, a watch, the dupatta folded or skipped
- After-work dinner: silver jhumkas, the dupatta on one shoulder, block heels
- Weekend brunch: sneakers or sandals, oxidised silver, the dupatta around the neck
- Errands or travel: the kurta with jeans and a denim jacket
- Winter: a long camel coat, thermal leggings and boots

## Why is indigo block print so easy to style?

Indigo is a deep blue with a soft, lived-in feel. It works like a dark neutral, so it pairs with almost everything: gold, silver, camel coats, white sneakers and denim jackets. It also hides small marks, which makes it practical for busy days.

The [indigo hand block print kota doria kurta set with printed cotton pants and dupatta](/products/indigo-hand-block-print-kota-doria-kurta-pant-dupatta-set/) combines a light kota doria kurta with printed cotton pants. The kurta feels airy and the pants feel soft and relaxed, which is ideal for long days.

If you want to learn about the craft and history of indigo, our [indigo block print guide](/blog/indigo-block-print-guide-how-to-style-an-indigo-kurta-set/) covers it in detail. Here, we focus on a week of wear.

## How can I wear it from Monday to Sunday?

| Day | Look | Add | Shoes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monday, office | Full set, dupatta folded | Watch, small studs | Loafers |
| Wednesday, client meeting | Full set, no dupatta | Tailored blazer | Block heels |
| Friday, dinner out | Full set, dupatta on one shoulder | Silver jhumkas, berry lip | Heels |
| Saturday, brunch | Full set, dupatta around the neck | Sunglasses, oxidised rings | Sandals or sneakers |
| Sunday, errands | Kurta with jeans | Denim jacket, tote | White sneakers |

## How do I wear it to the office?

For a workday, keep it clean and simple. Wear the full set and fold the dupatta neatly over one shoulder, or leave it at home. Add small gold or silver studs, a watch and loafers. On a cold day, a tailored blazer in camel or grey looks smart on top.

Our post on [Indian outfits for work in the USA](/blog/indian-outfits-for-work-in-the-usa/) shares more ideas for wearing kurta sets in a Western office.

## How do I wear it for the weekend?

On weekends, have fun with it. Wear the dupatta loosely around your neck like a scarf, add oxidised silver rings and jhumkas, and finish with sandals or white sneakers. Sunglasses and a woven tote make it brunch-ready.

You can also break the set up. Wear the kurta with jeans and a denim jacket for errands or travel, or wear the printed pants with a simple tunic.

The [sky blue hand block print cotton tunic top](/products/sky-blue-hand-block-print-cotton-tunic-top/) pairs well with the indigo printed pants for a lighter, fresher look.

> **From our Jaipur studio:** Our karigars print each motif with carved wooden blocks, pressing by hand and lining up each repeat by eye. On kota doria, the open weave takes the print softly, so the pattern looks gentle rather than sharp. Small variations in each print are the mark of handwork.

## How do I take it from day to evening?

For an after-work dinner, make three swaps. Change your studs for statement silver jhumkas. Drape the dupatta over one shoulder and pin it at the back. Add a berry or red lip and swap loafers for heels. In under five minutes, you are dinner-ready.

## How do I wear it in winter?

Kota doria is light, so it layers well without bulk. Wear thin thermal leggings under the pants and a fitted thermal top under the kurta. On top, a long camel, grey or black coat works beautifully with indigo. Boots outside, loafers or juttis inside.

## How do I care for an indigo block print set?

Wash it separately in cold water with a mild detergent for the first few washes, as a little extra dye may release. Dry in the shade, and iron on the reverse on low heat. Kota doria is delicate, so do not wring it. Our full guide on [how to wash and care for block printed cotton](/blog/how-to-wash-and-care-for-block-printed-cotton-kurtis/) has step-by-step tips.

Browse more in our [hand block print](/hand-block-print-kurta-sets/) collection.

## Our pick for you

The [indigo hand block print kurta set](/products/indigo-hand-block-print-kota-doria-kurta-pant-dupatta-set/) is a true office-to-weekend piece. A small etiquette note: in a formal office, check the dress code before wearing a dupatta-free kurta set to a client meeting.

## Frequently asked questions

**Can I wear a block print kurta set to the office?**
Yes. Indigo block print looks smart and professional. Pair it with loafers, studs and a blazer on cold days.

**What shoes go with an indigo kurta set?**
Loafers for the office, heels for dinner, and sandals or white sneakers for the weekend.

**Does indigo block print fade?**
It can soften slightly with time. Wash in cold water, dry in the shade and avoid harsh detergents to keep the colour rich.

**Can I wear the kurta with jeans?**
Yes. The kurta looks great with jeans and a denim jacket for errands, travel or casual weekends.
